nodes.name: North Main Entrance Gate
nodes.description: Primary vehicle and pedestrian entrance to the university campus with security checkpost and central bus stop.
floors: Ground Level: Security Control & Information Desk

nodes.name: Vice Chancellor Administration Block
nodes.description: Central administrative building housing executive office, registrar, admissions office, and finance division.
floors: Ground Floor: Visitor Reception & Help Desk

nodes.name: Sir M. Visvesvaraya Engineering Academic Block
nodes.description: Primary academic building containing state-of-the-art lecture halls, Computer Science labs, and AI research wings.
floors: Ground Floor: High Performance Computing Lab 1-4
2nd Floor: CS Department Faculty & Research Labs

nodes.name: Aryabhata Science & Innovation Complex
nodes.description: Interdisciplinary research facility dedicated to Nanotechnology, Applied Physics, and Biotechnology studies.
floors: 2nd Floor: Advanced Optics & Laser Physics Suite

nodes.name: Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Central Library
nodes.description: 5-story digital library with over 150,000 volumes, 24/7 quiet study zones, VR learning pods, and research archives.
floors: 3rd Floor: Digital Library & VR Media Lab

nodes.name: Olympia Athletics & Indoor Sports Center
nodes.description: Comprehensive sports arena including a 400m synthetic running track, indoor badminton courts, Olympic pool, and gym.
floors: Ground Level: 400m Running Track, Football Pitch & Tennis Courts
Indoor Facility: Swimming Pool, Badminton Courts & Fitness Gym

nodes.name: Central Campus Food Court & Dining Pavilion
nodes.description: Multi-cuisine food court offering organic meals, coffee kiosks, fresh bakery items, and student lounge area.
floors: Ground Floor: Multi-Cuisine Food Stalls & Espresso Bar
1st Floor: Terrace Lounge & Faculty Dining Room

nodes.name: Grand University Convention Center & Auditorium
nodes.description: State-of-the-art 2,500 seat auditorium equipped with Dolby Atmos acoustics for convocations, summits, and cultural galas.
floors: Ground Floor: Main Auditorium Hall & Stage

nodes.name: Bhabha Student Residential Hostel Block A & B
nodes.description: Modern student residential complex featuring high-speed Wi-Fi, study lounges, laundry facilities, and indoor game rooms.
floors: Ground Floor: Warden Office, Recreation Room & Laundry

nodes.name: Sarojini Naidu Women's Hostel Complex
nodes.description: Secure residential complex for undergraduate and postgraduate women students with dedicated dining mess and courtyard.
floors: Ground Floor: Dining Hall, Visitor Lounge & Warden Desk

nodes.name: Campus Wellness & Emergency Medical Center
nodes.description: Full-service health clinic providing 24/7 emergency response, doctor consultations, pharmacy, and ambulance service.
floors: Ground Floor: Emergency Triage, OPD Clinics & Pharmacy

nodes.name: North Gate Visitor & Student Parking P1
nodes.description: Shaded multi-level parking facility for cars, two-wheelers, and electric vehicle EV charging stations.
floors: Ground Level: EV Charging Stations & Two-Wheelers

nodes.name: South Academic Staff Parking P2
nodes.description: Reserved parking lot for faculty members, administrative staff, and university fleet buses.

nodes.name: Central Campus Shuttle Bus Station
nodes.description: Primary transit node for electric campus shuttles connecting residential hostels, academic blocks, and main gate.

nodes.name: North Gate Junction
nodes.description: Major road intersection near North Gate.

nodes.name: Central Campus Boulevard Crossroad
nodes.description: Central nexus connecting Academic Blocks, Library, and Bus Station.

nodes.name: South Quad Avenue Junction
nodes.description: Intersection connecting Administration Block, Medical Center, and Women's Hostel.

nodes.name: Sports Quad Road Junction
nodes.description: Access road junction for Sports Complex and West Academic Quad.

edges.instruction: Head South from North Gate toward North Gate Junction.
Turn East into North Visitor Parking P1.
Walk West along Residential Drive toward Bhabha Hostel Block.
Continue South along Main Campus Boulevard toward Central Bus Station.
Proceed South along Main Boulevard to Central Campus Crossroad.
Turn West onto Science Plaza toward Aryabhata Science Block.
Walk West across the Academic Courtyard to Visvesvaraya Engineering Block.
Walk West toward Sports Quad Junction.
Proceed North along Stadium Drive to Olympia Athletics Center.
Walk South along Knowledge Way to Kalam Central Library.
Walk South along Dining Promenade to Central Food Court.
Continue South along Main Boulevard to South Quad Avenue Junction.
Turn West into Vice Chancellor Administration Block.
Turn East into Emergency Medical Center.
Walk West along Convention Drive to Grand University Auditorium.
Walk North to Staff Parking P2.
Walk South-East along Hostel Road to Sarojini Naidu Women's Hostel.
